Name: Jairus
Summary: Jairus was a ruler of the synagogue whose twelve-year-old daughter was dying. He begged Jesus to come, believed through the news of her death, and saw Jesus take her by the hand and raise her.
KeyStory: Jairus heard that his daughter was dead, and Jesus told him, Fear not, believe only, and she shall be made whole.
LifeLesson: Bad news is not the last word when Jesus is on the way. Jairus believed past the point of hope.
